payload.title: Full Rust and CDP suite, warning-free builds

payload.cmd: cd code && cargo test && cd apps/rusty-brick-chess/frontend && cargo check --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
payload.name: full-suite

payload.note: All 12 cdp_*.js suites pass via check_all.sh --cdp from a clean database.
The AI suites (stream, context, scopes, approvals, play, watch, match ui, cross board, session, rail, rail2, pin) all report their PASS marker.

Triage in check_all.sh and its notes: port 8100 contention (the three self-hosting suites vs a shared mock) is now two fixed groups; order dependence (approvals reading another suite's board and queue) is a queue reset plus a freshest-board rule in the mock; AI_RAIL2_PASS was invisible to a marker regex without digits; cdp_session needs a legacy_sessions row to see the reset notice.

Clippy cleanup, partially done. Seven crates now pass cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings: knightlm-core (single-pattern match, useless format!, and a branch in vision.rs that chose between two identical ink colours - the glyph already carries the side, so it is one constant now), knightlm-notation (loop counter, is_multiple_of, contains), knightlm-engine (a seven-tuple MultiPV type replaced with a module-scope alias), rbc-context (derived Default, div_ceil, collapsible ifs), knightlm-cli and brick-chess (is_multiple_of, collapsed ifs, a needless reference), rbc-db (a useless format! around SQL with no placeholders, and create_ai_session's seven &str arguments bundled into SessionProfile so the call sites stop being a guessing game). Two I did NOT nudge: policy.rs's duplicate Allow arms were a genuine equivalence and are merged with a comment, and vision.rs's identical colours were dead branching rather than a colour choice. Still failing: crates/ai (15) and knightlm-model (7) under --all-features. Tests are green on both feature sets and cargo build emits zero warnings; fmt is clean. Note the repo's own Makefile gate runs clippy -D warnings, so 'make check' is still not green and has evidently not been for a while - worth deciding whether the remaining 22 are fixed or allowed by policy.

Clippy is now clean on both feature sets: 0 errors for --workspace --all-targets with and without --all-features. That needed 30-odd lints across every crate, finished in crates/ai (collapsible ifs, a let-else that wanted ?, a let-then-return tail, Ok(..?) with nothing added, Default-then-assign, a loop counter, a complex type alias) and knightlm-model (parity stubs). Two judgement calls worth recording: SessionTalk bundles the model/context/permissions triple so Store::create_session stops taking eight positional arguments where three were JSON strings; and result_large_err is allowed with a reason on the three helpers whose Err *is* the ToolResult handed back as the whole answer, where boxing would move an allocation and shrink nothing. Also: knightlm-model's parity battery had six assert!(false) stubs (deliberately red) and one assert!(true) which cannot fail - it read as a passing test while checking nothing, and now every stub is unimplemented!() with its original message. STILL OPEN: i-2c3b, because it asks for server/frontend/Tauri checks and there is no Tauri shell in this repository - server and frontend checks are green, so the remaining question is whether Tauri is in R1 scope at all.

Why this sits at 3/5: i-2e5c (workspace cargo test) is refused by the dependency graph because it waits on t-a994 (tournament UI and end-to-end), t-5ede (study tests), t-7e84 (compare tests and read-only guard), t-3241 (MCP docs and mock client tests), t-c5a4 (performance and load) and t-69c9 (security review) - all still open. A full-suite ticket cannot be full while six suites do not exist yet. What IS verified now: cargo test green on both feature sets, clippy -D warnings clean on both, fmt clean, zero compiler warnings, and all 12 CDP suites passing through scripts/check_all.sh. Those six tickets are the prerequisite order for finishing this one.
